titulo: 'Peaky Blinders' fans can now immerse themselves in the Shelby underworld in London
cuerpo: Fans of 'Peaky Blinders' can now step into the fictional world of the Shelby family at a new immersive experience near London Bridge. Visitors can explore the Garrison Tavern, take on missions, place bets and interact with characters in an underworld inspired by the hit series.
